item.title: Daily Minute — September 17, 2026
item.description:
Stand quietly within this circle, and attract all tortured minds to join with you in the safety of its peace and holiness. Abide with me within it, as teachers of Atonement, NOT of guilt.

item.title: Lesson 94: “I am as God created me.”
item.description: “I am as God created me.” Today we continue with the one idea which brings complete salvation; the one statement which makes all forms of temptation powerless; the one thought which renders the ego silent and entirely undone.
